title: Glyph placement follows the runs' declared face, not the paragraph style's face
source: probe build.py -> word.pdf: first baseline on a fresh page = the declared face's own single line minus its own hhea descent (TNR 10.32, Georgia 10.08, Arial 10.32, Cambria 10.56 under a Calibri 11 Normal; Calibri control 10.56); the paragraph mark's face does not count

cases.note: Calibri runs under Calibri Normal: no inline box, the style rule's box applies
TNR runs under Calibri Normal: the paragraph carries TNR's box (Word first baseline 10.32 = 12.66 - 2.38)
TNR runs with a TNR paragraph mark: same box as block 2 (Word 10.32 either way)
